src/app/app.component.ts: The shell itself — router outlet, navbar, toast and keyword sheet. Every route capture in shoot.js is a capture of it.
src/app/components/navbar/navbar.compone: Chrome present in every shoot.js route capture at both phone widths, and its collapsed drawer is driven by e2e/_verify-nav-rules.js.
src/app/components/card-search-panel/car: Covered by e2e/verify-same.js, which pixel-diffs its filter block against the other three hosts.
src/app/components/user-avatar/user-avat: A fixed-size circle with no layout of its own, rendered inside surfaces the harness already captures: the players grid (shoot.js 'players'), the profile hero (shoot.js 'profile') and the account page (shoot.js 'account').
src/app/components/card/card.component.t: Rendered inside the board, which shoot-states.js now captures as board / board-ability-menu / board-announce-x. Nothing in e2e/ names this component or a class from its own stylesheet yet, so it is registered only by proxy. Name one and remove this entry. (The board itself is capturable since helpers/game-replay.js grew a hub connection: a socket that failed to open was a connectionError, and that effect clears the session and routes home before anything is photographed.)
